rawContent: Join us at the Men & the #MeToo Movement conference in Philadelphia. Our executive director will be giving a keynote, "From Sit-ins to Social Media: The Evolution of College-Based Sexual Violence Prevention." You won't want to miss it! https://t.co/EfimcaBonU

If you are wondering if you play a role in preventing sexual violence, the answer is YES. Let's talk about it. Join @MertzJessica at the Men & the #MeToo Movement Conference Nov 14 & 15. https://t.co/0AfkDO6bFh
